record_format: one JSON object per line in EVIDENCE.jsonl; matching fields in EVIDENCE.csv

required_fields.source_family: github, reddit, hacker_news, stack_overflow, forum, engineering_blog, review, video_transcript, social, official_docs, other
required_fields.published_at: ISO date or null if unavailable
required_fields.event_at: ISO date or null if unavailable
required_fields.public_author_reference: public handle/source ID only when relevant to deduplication; otherwise null
required_fields.incident_dedup_key: same person plus same underlying incident across copies and threads
required_fields.segment_basis: what establishes the segment; null if unknown
required_fields.evidence_type: first_person_report, maintainer_confirmation, independent_measurement, official_capability, vendor_claim, secondhand_report
required_fields.user_goal: task the person was trying to complete
required_fields.workflow_moment: discover_install, navigate_understand, before_edit, during_edit, check_test, review_merge, return_use, buy_renew, other
required_fields.short_excerpt: brief exact excerpt if useful; otherwise null; keep total verbatim material from each non-Reddit source within 25 words across delivered artifacts
required_fields.source_locator: comment anchor, paragraph, timestamp, line or other supporting location
required_fields.resolution_source_url: official or maintainer resolution link or null
required_fields.theme_tags: array of shared pain/success theme tags
required_fields.fit_reasoning: explicit inference about actual Codeweb mechanism; keep separate from reported facts
required_fields.contradicts_evidence_ids: array of IDs, may be empty
required_fields.notes_and_limits: access, source bias, ambiguity and other material limits

rules: Inaccessible sources cannot support a final finding.
Crossposts and repeated descriptions of one incident count once.
Anecdote counts describe the collected corpus, not population prevalence.
Separate observed/reported facts from Codeweb-fit inference.
No simulated interviews, inferred private profiles or invented buying intent.
